answer: Reaching the ocean of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a pragmatic engineering perspective, trade-offs first register, it stays short. The design leans on liquidity provision incentives with impermanent loss hedging. The sonnet holds work receipts rather than names, so the meadow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
